comment: One switch for diagnostics across the whole stack.
Debugging this mod means debugging three at once, and each keeps its settings
somewhere different: AAF takes them at runtime through its API, anything with
an MCM page takes them by name, and the engine's Papyrus logging is an ini the
game reads once at startup. A profile here drives all three.
Everything Rapport changes is named in Rapport.log, because the point of this
is not switching diagnostics on - it is switching them reliably back off.
The papyrus flags take effect on the NEXT launch, not this one, and Rapport
says so when it writes them. Fallout4Custom.ini is backed up once, the first
Ship with active = off. Papyrus tracing slows the script engine, which is the
exact cost this mod exists to avoid adding to.
